title: Decision tree clauses
statement: For each decision tree on $n$ Boolean variables, define a list of clauses recursively. A true leaf yields no clauses, a false leaf yields the single empty clause, and a branch querying variable $v$ yields the clauses from its false subtree prefixed by the positive literal for $v$, followed by the clauses from its true subtree prefixed by the negated literal for $v$.
